annotations.title: Explain a Dutch tax, work or daily-life term

description: Explains Dutch terms from tax letters, job ads, housing, health and government (vakantiegeld, aanslag, toeslagen, eigen risico, jaarruimte, cao, ORT, IKB, WOZ, BSN, DigiD...). Job-ad terms are explained in 20 languages (en, nl, de, fr, pl, tr, ar, uk, ru, hi, ro, bg, it, es, pt, zh, el, hu, id, fa); the other terms in English or Dutch, for the assistant to translate.

language.description: Two-letter language code for the explanation, e.g. pl, tr, hi. Default en.

term.description: The Dutch term, or its English meaning (e.g. "vakantiegeld" or "holiday allowance")

name: dutch_term_explained
